questions.question: When about three thousand Israelite men went up to attack the city of Ai, what happened?

answers.text: They fled before the men of Ai
They captured Ai in one day

questions.question: After Israel lost at Ai, the LORD told Joshua He would no longer be with Israel unless they removed what was devoted to destruction. True or false?
How did the LORD say Joshua would find the man who took the things devoted to destruction?

answers.text: The LORD would choose tribe by tribe down to one man
Joshua would search every tent in the camp
Joshua would have every man come and confess

questions.question: What did Achan confess to taking from the spoils and hiding in his tent?

answers.text: A cloak and silver and a gold bar
A crown and a sword and a shield
Bronze pots and a few iron tools
